"Deploying batcher and KV-cache tuning to improve throughput and token efficiency for text-generation. Typical workloads see cost/throughput improvements. Canary 20:00 UTC; ops monitoring active; rollback plan in runbook. Contact @simon for ops."

simon: oncall and ready. I'll run smoke suite and set alerts: page if error_rate >0.5% or p95 increases >200ms.
